title: Move anything
text:
The World Editor can now move and remove the world's own objects, not only the ones you added.

✨ World Editor: click and drag anything the game placed: street lamps, market stalls, crate stacks, campfires, the Southlands farmsteads and camps, NPCs, monsters and landmarks
✨ World Editor: delete any of them with Delete (NPCs can be moved but not removed, because quests depend on them). Moved objects show a line back to where they were, and "Put back where it was" or "Restore all" undoes it
✨ World Editor: trees and rocks can be dragged to a new spot or deleted too, and the ground underneath fills in to match
✨ World Editor: Duplicate or copy any original object to get your own copy, to spread lamps, stalls or monsters around the world
⬆️ World Editor: every original object is listed in the Hierarchy under Original world, with a filter
